title: Convair FISH three-view technical drawing with dimensions (Chapter 6)
description: Technical three-view drawing of the Convair FISH reconnaissance aircraft design, captioned "Convair FISH." Views include a planform with a 67° sweep angle, a front view with a 444" (37') span, and a side view 564" (47') long and 10'1" high. A small inset labeled "Under a B-58B" shows the vehicle carried beneath a B-58 bomber. Chapter 6, page 264.
